open.title: Paint the back bedroom
open.overview: Wash, fill and prime the cracked plaster, two coats on the walls and the trim in the old cream.

comments.author: person-seat-a
comments.body: Three cracks on the window wall and one over the door. Filled and left overnight.

comments.author: person-seat-b
comments.body: Walls done in oat, two coats. Two gallons was right with a little over for touching up. Sixty eight dollars with the primer.

comments.author: person-seat-a
comments.body: Trim done and the bed moved back in. It is the best room in the house in the morning now.
